name: computer-use-mcp-workspace
description: Clean-room macOS computer control over local MCP

scripts.markdown:lint: markdownlint-cli2 --config .github/markdownlint-cli2.jsonc README.md SECURITY.md CONTRIBUTING.md PRIVACY.md THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 'docs/**/*.md' 'examples/**/*.md' 'sbom/**/*.md' 'tests/**/*.md' '.github/**/*.md'
scripts.setup: npm run setup:local && npm run build --workspace @jmeguilos/computer-use-mcp && node packages/mcp/dist/index.js setup
scripts.doctor: npm run build --workspace @jmeguilos/computer-use-mcp && node packages/mcp/dist/index.js doctor
scripts.verify: npm run diff:check && npm run audit && npm run provenance:scan && npm run version:verify && npm run examples:validate && npm run markdown:lint && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run swift:test && npm run swift:build && npm run swift:universal && npm run pack:verify
